$description: Tier 3 · Component knobs for the shell's frame (packages/ui: app-frame.tsx and the frame parts beside it, context-panel.tsx, settings-frame.tsx), merged with component.json at build and emitted as --c-*. The width table (contract 5.1b #14): one knob per column the four apps draw, at the width Figma draws it at 1440, plus the least widths the frame keeps when a window is narrower. Widths on the 4px spacing scale that the frame uses as gutters and gaps (48, 24, 16, 12) need no knob. Re-declares app-frame.sidebar-width (the sidebar is now the navigation column, 204). Late additions (contract 5.1c): the list + detail split gap (C8) and the pull-to-refresh distances (C9).

sidebar-width.$description: AppFrameSidebar, the navigation column of Vale, Lockdown and Synapse: 204 wide, as every desktop frame draws it (x 48 to 252 at 1440). Re-declared from component.json, where it was the old list column (18rem).

sidebar-rail.$description: The sidebar collapsed to its rail (by choice, or at medium width): one column of rail items, 48 wide (Rail Item, Figma 44:106). Synapse's brief counts 56; the drawn rail item is 48.

list.$description: AppFrameList, the list beside the detail in the sidebar apps: 432 (Vale, Lockdown and Synapse at 1440: x 276 to 708, then 12 to the column rule).

list-compact.$description: The list in an expanded window under 1280 wide (Lockdown 4.0: 320 under 1280), and the least a list gets beside a detail (contract 5.1c C8).

list-narrow.$description: AppFrameList size="narrow": Warpcore's chat list beside the conversation, 270 (chat workspace frames: x 48 to 318).

detail.$description: The detail column as the sidebar apps draw it at 1440 (648: x 744 to 1392). It fills there; the knob is the peek's width (Synapse Y-03: a sheet over the right 648 of the content).

detail-narrow.$description: AppFrameDetail size="narrow": a detail of fixed width beside a list that fills, as Warpcore's Tasks and Docs draw it (534: x 858 to 1392).

detail-min.$description: The least a detail (or a conversation) gets beside a list or a companion: 480 (Warpcore U-03, contract 5.1c C8).

split-gap.$description: The gap a list + detail screen counts between its two columns when it decides what to give up (contract 5.1c C8: 320 + 24 + 480 = 824). Narrower content than list-compact + split-gap + detail-min shows the sidebar as its rail; narrower still, the detail is pushed as at medium width.

reading.$description: AppFrameReading, the reading column: 720 at most (UX Patterns: 720 to 768; Warpcore's conversation in the rail and focus frames, x 474 to 1194).

side-panel.$description: AppFrameSidePanel, a third column beside the detail (Vale's sender panel, Synapse's activity): 312 (Synapse 4.0).

side-panel-room.$description: How wide the detail must be before a side panel stands beside it as a column; under it the panel is a sheet from the side (Vale 3.2: 960).

beside.$description: The beside pane: an artifact open beside the chat (Warpcore chat workspace 06: 696, x 696 to 1392), and AppFrameCompanion's starting width.

beside-min.$description: The least a beside pane gets while it is dragged narrower (Warpcore U-10: 480).

context-panel.$description: ContextPanel open: 400 (Warpcore chat workspace 01: x 992 to 1392).

context-panel-min.$description: ContextPanel's least width while it is dragged (Warpcore N-17: 320 to 560).

settings-list.$description: SettingsFrame's section list on desktop: 204 (cross-app decisions §5).

focus.$description: AppFrameFocus, the one centred column for sign-in, unlock and first run: 432 (cross-app decisions §4, §14).

minimize-threshold.$description: How far the phone's content scrolls before the chrome minimizes (the large title has gone under the top row by then): 64. A behaviour distance, not motion; useScrollMinimize reads it once a scroller attaches and falls back to this value without the stylesheet.

scroll-edge.$description: How long the bottom scroll edge's fade is: content fades into the ground over 80 (Vale Mobile / 01: y 640 to 720), then the ground is solid down to the screen's end.

scroll-edge-solid.$description: How far above the phone's bottom row the ground is already solid: 40. The fade is fixed to the row, not to the chrome's top: Vale Mobile / 01 fades from y 640 to 720 with the row at 760, and Lockdown Mobile / 01, with a status strip at 704, fades over the same 640 to 720.

pull-threshold.$description: Pull to refresh (contract 5.1c C9, Lockdown LA6): how far a finger pulls down from the top of a phone column before letting go runs the refresh: 64. A behaviour distance, read at the press, with this value as the fallback.

pull-max.$description: The furthest the content moves under a pull (128): it follows the finger with resistance (rubberBand) and never passes this. Not used under reduced motion, where the content does not move.

pull-slop.$description: How far a finger moves before the column decides whether it is a pull (down, more down than sideways) or the browser's (scroll, a row's swipe): 8.
